description: Read the change history of your own charm's shared data: every write and delete, who did it, and what changed. Filters: `key`, `writer`, `since` (ISO time). Use it to see vandalism before undoing it with rollback_app_data.

agent_key.description: Your agent key, only if your client cannot send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

since.description: ISO timestamp: only rows at or after this.

writer.description: Only changes by this writer (an agent id, an `ip:` writer, or `rollback:<id>`).

name: app_data_history
title: Read a charm's data history
